statement: Talent Book Library is unlocked in the Construction Workbench; first level unlocks use of the Library.
Further Construction Workbench upgrades increase Checkout Refresh Speed.
Library upgrades the maximum level of each of your talents; the VIP Bookshelf is a second section.
Select base class (Warrior/Archer/Mage) then talent tree tab then the talent to upgrade; tabs after tab 1 are elite classes.
Selecting a talent displays its maximum level above your character so you can see whether upgrading is needed.
More checkouts held means longer time for next checkout; one checkout takes an hour but around 10-12 takes over a day per book.
Checking out a book drops it on the ground; pick it up to see the total max level it would give your talent.
Example: wants to upgrade Apocalypse Chow elite talent for the Cooking benefits.
You can check out several books at once; results vary so it takes chance to get the level you want.
Automation Arm's last upgrade Book Reservation System lets you spend 20 books at once and guarantees the highest unlocked maximum level.
After spending 20 checkouts the book gave 155 max level; hold it and click on the talent to boost it to 155.
At base the book range is between 101 and 125.
Fifth Salt Lick upgrade gives up to 20 additional max levels for Library talent books.
World 3 Merit Shop upgrade gives 10 additional possible max levels for talent books.
World 3 Achievement Checkout Takeout requires checking out 1000 books from the Library.
Checkout Takeout achievement gives 5 additional max levels and increases Library charge rate by 30%.
Check out books as often as possible since the 1000 checkouts takes a lot of time.
Library Double Agent bribe bot increases minimum level by 4 and costs about 10 platinum.
Gem shop Burning Bad Books has four upgrades totaling 1450 gems for up to 20 minimum level.
World 1 Biblio Stamp gives 1% more Library refresh speed per level.
World 2 Alchemy bubble Ignore Overdues (number 11) increases book checkout speed.
Chonker Chug vial gives a minor but decent boost to talent checkout speed.
Fortune Cookie meal gives a quite big bonus to Library checkout speed.
VIP Bookshelf follows same checkout rules; five special talent books in Star Talents unlock via different VIP membership levels.
Last VIP book needs about 150 VIP membership; each attempt costs 5 checkouts
explicit: follows max level but min level is always 1 so many checkouts needed.

statement: Garlic Bread meal gives the base VIP Membership.
Sour Fish and Orange meals also give additional VIP Membership.
Pet Arena bonuses give VIP Membership as early as round 5 and the next boost at round 80 is large.
